mapper.sql: select s.ship_id, s.ship_no, s.shipped_at, l.ship_line_id, s.plant_cd, s.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, l.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.unit_cd, i.lot_ctrl_yn, x.lot_id, lm.lot_no, x.shipped as shipped_qty, coalesce(r.returned, 0) as returned_qty, greatest(x.shipped - coalesce(r.returned, 0), 0) as open_qty from (select p.ship_line_id, p.lot_id, -sum(t.qty) as shipped from wms_ship_pick p join inv_trx t on t.comp_cd = p.comp_cd and t.src_type = 'SHIP_PICK' and t.src_id = p.pick_id and t.trx_type = 'SHIP' where group by p.ship_line_id, p.lot_id having sum(t.qty) <> 0) x join wms_ship_line l on l.ship_line_id = x.ship_line_id join wms_ship s on s.ship_id = l.ship_id join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = s.cust_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id left join lot_master lm on lm.lot_id = x.lot_id left join lateral (select sum(q.qty) as returned from wms_cust_rtn q where q.ship_line_id = x.ship_line_id and q.lot_id is not distinct from x.lot_id and q.status = 'RECEIVED') r on true where s.plant_cd = #{plantCd}
mapper.select: select * from () z where z.open_qty > 0 order by z.shipped_at desc, z.ship_id desc, z.ship_line_id, z.lot_id nulls first limit #{limit}
and x.lot_id is not distinct from #{lotId}
select s.status from wms_ship s where s.ship_id = #{shipId} for share
mapper.sql: r.rtn_id, r.rtn_no, r.plant_cd, r.status, r.ship_id, s.ship_no, r.ship_line_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, r.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, r.unit_cd, r.lot_id, lm.lot_no, r.qty, r.reason_cd, r.node_id, wms_node_path(r.node_id) as node_path, r.remark, r.capa_no, r.ncr_id, r.ncr_no, r.client_req_id, r.received_at, r.received_by, r.cancel_reason, r.cancelled_at, r.cancelled_by, r.row_ver
from wms_cust_rtn r join wms_ship s on s.ship_id = r.ship_id join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = r.cust_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = r.item_id left join lot_master lm on lm.lot_id = r.lot_id
mapper.select: select r.rtn_id, r.status, r.row_ver, r.ncr_id, r.rtn_no from wms_cust_rtn r where r.rtn_id = #{rtnId} for update

insert into wms_cust_rtn (comp_cd, rtn_no, plant_cd, cust_id, ship_id, ship_line_id, item_id, lot_id, qty, unit_cd, reason_cd, node_id, remark, capa_no, client_req_id, received_at, received_by, performed_by, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{rtnNo}, #{s.plantCd}, #{s.custId}, #{s.shipId}, #{s.shipLineId}, #{s.itemId}, #{s.lotId}, #{qty}, #{s.unitCd}, #{reasonCd}, #{nodeId}, #{remark}, #{capaNo}, #{reqId}, now(), #{by}, #{performedBy}, #{by}, #{by}) returning rtn_id
mapper.update: update wms_cust_rtn set ncr_id = #{ncrId}, ncr_no = #{ncrNo}, updated_at = now() where rtn_id = #{rtnId}

update wms_cust_rtn set status = 'CANCELLED', cancel_reason = #{reason}, cancelled_at = now(), cancelled_by = #{by}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where rtn_id = #{rtnId} and status = 'RECEIVED'
mapper.select: select t.trx_id from inv_trx t where t.src_type = 'CUST_RTN' and t.src_id = #{rtnId} and t.trx_type = 'RCV_RTN' and t.reversal_of_id is null and not exists (select 1 from inv_trx b where b.reversal_of_id = t.trx_id) order by t.trx_id
